mechanism-sum.alt: Two elementary steps stacked and added. Step 1: two nitrogen dioxide molecules form NO3 and NO. Step 2: NO3 and carbon monoxide form nitrogen dioxide and carbon dioxide. NO3 is formed in step 1 and used in step 2, so it cancels: it is an intermediate. One NO2 on each side also cancels. The sum is the overall equation, NO2 plus CO gives NO plus CO2.
